messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High p99 latency detected on /streaming/generate (us-west-2). SLO p99=500ms breached for ~12m. p95 elevated. Cache miss rate for prefix-cache-v2 jumped. Affected: multiple PLG customers; one visible customer (customer-acme) showing 504s. Paging on-call: @maya.

maya: I'm on it. pulling dashboard + logs. first glance: p99 ~= 1.2s, p95 ~= 320ms. cache hitrate 18% (expected ~72%). I see a recent config change to prefix-hash-v2 rolled ~20m ago.

ryan: I can scrub the deploy logs. I saw a rollout to 50% earlier — maybe the hash salt changed. checking diff now.

priya: If prefix-hash changed, that would evaporate the cache. Any recent rollout id or feature flag?

maya: roll id: deploy-2026-03-08-ctx-1947 (from telemetry). Feature flag: prefix-hash-v2:enabled=true at 2026-03-08T10:02UTC.

lucas: Support: customer-acme reported timeouts at 10:25. They saw streaming stalls and partial responses. They're on a paid Dedicated plan; ticket #11234 open.

emma: Noted. We should prioritize mitigation rather than full rollback to avoid further pain. Can we warm the cache somehow?

maya: Mitigations I'm trying now: 1) increase prefetch workers for prefix-cache service to 4x to accelerate warmup; 2) enable fallback routing to prefix-cache-v1 (stable) for critical traffic; 3) limit burst traffic via rate-limit rule on ingress for non-prod keys.

priya: Good. I can flip the routing to send 20% of traffic to v1 as a quick fallback. Command I'm using: 
```
# route 20% to prefix-cache-v1
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/routes/split -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/streaming/generate","buckets":[{"tag":"pref-v1","pct":20},{"tag":"pref-v2","pct":80}]}'
```

maya: Applying scale on prefetch deployment now.
```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/prefix-prefetch --replicas=12
```

deploy-bot: Deployment prefix-prefetch scaled to 12 replicas (request by maya).

sentry-bot: New error spike: stream-handler: downstream write timeout (ETIMEDOUT) increased x3 since 10:18 UTC.

ryan: I pulled the rollout diff. Change: prefix-hash salt was updated (salt=b2f4 -> salt=8c1a) and bloom filter settings lowered for memory optimization. That could reduce collisions but invalidates cached keys. The rollout notes did not include a staged rehash or backfill.

maya: That matches — cache invalidations explain hit-rate crash. For immediate relief I'd prefer a config rollback of the salt, but that's invasive. Ops, can we toggle the feature flag off? ops_lead: any objections to flip flag to disable prefix-hash-v2?

ops_lead: Flip it if it restores SLOs quickly. But do coordinate — flipping back to previous salt needs to ensure clients and all replicas use same salt. I'll approve temporary disable.

ops_lead: Action: turning prefix-hash-v2 flag -> false.

deploy-bot: Feature flag prefix-hash-v2 set to false by ops_lead via ops-console at 10:43 UTC.

maya: Observability: within 2 minutes after toggling the flag, cache hitrate climbing: 18% -> 46% -> 68%. p99 trending down from 1.2s -> 0.6s -> 0.45s.

lucas: Customer-acme confirms improved latency and fewer timeouts. They're still seeing some retries but better. Support updated ticket #11234.

priya: We should still do a controlled backfill to warm any backend caches and run an integrity check on prefix keys. I'm starting a backfill job that samples hot prefixes from metrics and re-inserts them.

maya: Backfill command (running):
```
jobsctl start backfill --service prefix-cache --window 30m --concurrency 50 --sample hot
```

ryan: I'm going to file an RCA note and capture the rollout checklist gap. Immediate corrective: revert the salt change and enforce staged rollout with cache-warmup step. Longer term: add an automatic prewarm when hash changes.

emma: Also call out customer impact in the postmortem. We had degraded streaming SLA for ~20m for some customers. Need owners for communications. Lucas, you and I coordinate external comms?

lucas: Yep. I'll draft a brief status update for customer-acme and send to account team.

maya: We're stabilizing. p99 back under SLO ~0.45s. Will monitor for 30 minutes.

priya: Logged follow-ups: 1) add prewarm to rollout docs; 2) add deploy-time gate to prevent salt flip without backfill; 3) add alert for sudden cache hitrate delta > 30%.

ryan: Adding a runbook entry now: "prefix-hash-rollout -> must run cache backfill job and validate hitrate before ramp to >10%".

maya: OK team — I'll hand off to @ryan for the night shift in 45m. Handoff checklist:
- current status: stable, p99=0.45s, hitrate=71%
- actions taken: scaled prefetch, toggled feature flag to false, started backfill job, routed 20% to v1 then removed once stable
- open tasks: complete backfill (eta 18m), validate under load test, follow up RCA draft
- contacts: ops_lead (pager), priya (runtime), lucas (support)

ryan: Taking handoff. I'll keep 1h watch and escalate to ops_lead if p99 > 700ms or hitrate falls < 60%.

maya: Thanks — filing incident ticket and marking for postmortem. I'll add logs/graphs to the ticket.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and documented: incident-2026-03-08-1738208642. Postmortem owner: ryan.

lucas: Customer comms draft sent to account team; will update once postmortem ready.

maya: Final note before I sign off: avoid direct salt flips without rehash/backfill in future. Adding owners for the change: priya + runtime.

ryan: Copy. We'll schedule a retro tomorrow and create the deploy safety gate. Handoff complete.
